steps.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: revised film-location reference for the fictional food-delivery comedy ad "The Last Fry".
Input image 1: edit target, the existing living-room reference.
Primary request: transform this living room into a spacious, believable contemporary industrial loft and show it from a clear THREE-QUARTER FRONT-LEFT view. Position the camera near the front-left corner of the living area, looking diagonally about 45 degrees across the coffee table toward the sofa and the entrance on the back-right. Show the front and right-side depth of the sofa, two sides of the coffee table, and the relationship between the seating area and door. Wide 16:9 cinematic room view, natural slightly elevated standing eye level, vertical lines straight.
Architecture changes: higher exposed timber-and-steel ceiling, warm exposed brick along the back wall, large black steel-framed loft windows along the left wall, open-plan volume and generous usable floor space. The loft remains a comfortable real apartment rather than a warehouse. Entrance door on the back-right is fully visible and connected to the seating area by an unobstructed walking path.
Preserve the identifiable original furniture and colours: muted teal fabric three-seat sofa, cream and mustard cushions, rounded rectangular oak coffee table, warm neutral armchair, neutral woven rug, floor lamp, plants, inviting warm late-afternoon sunlight. Keep the coffee tabletop completely empty. Preserve credible relative furniture sizes and enough floor space for four friends and playful cushion action.
Composition: show the entire coffee table, full sofa, armchair, tall windows and entrance clearly, with depth and a strong diagonal arrangement. Crop neither the primary furniture nor the door. Warm photorealistic cinematic textures, comfortable lived-in set dressing, no dramatic change in colour palette.
Constraints: one single photorealistic location image. No people, no food, no delivery bags, no boxes, no phones, no words, no logos, no watermark. No collage, no isometric cutaway, no dollhouse, no top-down bird's-eye view, no front-on symmetrical view, no fisheye or stretched geometry. All existing key furniture should remain recognisable.
